Mid-market baseline:
1 EUR = 1.09 USD
95,000 EUR = 95,000 * 1.09 = 103,550.00 USD

1) bank:
Sell rate = 1.09 * (1 + 1.5%) = 1.09 * 1.015 = 1.10635 USD/EUR
EUR to buy = 95,000 + 15 wire fee = 95,015 EUR
Total USD = 95,015 * 1.10635
= 95,000 * 1.10635 + 15 * 1.10635
= 105,103.25 + 16.59525
= 105,119.85 USD approx

2) platform:
Sell rate = 1.09 * (1 + 0.2%) = 1.09 * 1.002 = 1.09218 USD/EUR
USD converted = 95,000 * 1.09218 = 103,757.10 USD
Fee = 0.35% of USD amount
Total USD = 103,757.10 * (1 + 0.0035)
= 103,757.10 + 363.15
= 104,120.25 USD approx

3) usd pay to supplier:
Supplier rate = 1.09 * (1 + 2%) = 1.09 * 1.02 = 1.1118 USD/EUR
USD before discount = 95,000 * 1.1118 = 105,621.00 USD
Less 1% early-payment discount:
Total USD = 105,621.00 * 0.99 = 104,564.79 USD

Comparison:
bank ~105,119.85
platform ~104,120.25
usd ~104,564.79

Cheapest is platform.
